text:
ryan: Heads-up — I'm planning to roll a change that tweaks routing weights and the per-route quota semantics for high-throughput customers. Thinking of a "safe_mode" approach + dry-run telemetry gate. Anyone object?
sasha: +1 to safe_mode. need clear metrics to auto-abort.
aj: what metrics are we gating on? p50/p95? error-rate? quota-exhaustion?
ryan: p50 and p95 latency, 5m error rate, token-cost delta vs baseline, and percent of requests that hit fallback. Also watch KV cache hit rate.
marie: also track quota_throttle_events and successful_429_rate. if quota throttles spike, auto-revert.
ryan: proposal: default "safe_mode": true for 48h after rollout. dry_run: true so we log decisions but don't enforce. telemetry gate checks after 30m and 2h.
devex: for console UX: add a "Dry Run" toggle + a preview pane that shows estimated routing distribution and quota headroom by cohort. Must be obvious this is not enforced.
ryan: sample config we'd push to runtime: ```json
{
  "route": "embeddings-prod",
  "routing": {"policy":"latency_aware", "weights": {"xlarge": 60, "xsmall": 40}, "fallback":"small-model"},
  "quota": {"type":"adaptive", "max_tokens_per_min": 50000},
  "safe_mode": true,
  "dry_run": true
}
```
aj: minor: add "abort_on": {"p95_latency_ms": 2000, "error_rate_pct": 0.5, "quota_throttle_rate_pct": 1.0} so the runtime can auto-abort.
ryan: good call. We'll wire thresholds to the rollout UI and allow overrides per-cohort.
marie: how do we sample cohorts? random sampling + user-level sticky hashing? we should prefer sticky to avoid oscillation.
ops: +1 sticky cohorts. also need a kill-switch in console that does immediate rollback to previous routing snapshot.
devex: I'll mock the UI: left column: config diff, middle: dry-run impact graphs (latency, cost, throttles), right: cohort selector + abort thresholds. add a small banner: "Dry run — no enforcement".
ryan: deployment plan: 1) change schema to accept safe_mode/dry_run flags (safe default true), 2) backend: dry-run path that logs decisions to telemetry_topic 'config.dryrun', 3) rollout 10% sticky cohort for 1h, check gate, then 25/50/100.
marie: telemetry gating: create a single dashboard with these panels: p50/p95 latency per-route, error rate, throttle events, fallback-rate, token-cost delta. Alert rules: auto-abort if any threshold breached for 3 consecutive windows.
ryan: can deploy-bot post canary deploy events so we have markers in graphs?
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: embeddings-config-safe-mode v2 -> cohort 10% at 2311112260. I will post deploy markers to the telemetry stream. :white_check_mark:
aj: question: if dry_run=false but safe_mode=true, we still enforce config but allow fallback automations?
ryan: semantics: safe_mode=true means conservative rollbacks allowed + circuit-breaker enabled. dry_run=false means config enforced. dry_run=true = no enforcement, only telemetry.
sasha: make sure runtime ids for snapshots are immutable and we can reapply previous snapshot with a single API call. logs must include snapshot_id and cohort_id.
ops: lastly, add a quick CLI snippet to abort: `rictl rollout abort --snapshot SNAPSHOT_ID --reason "safe_gate"` and wire that into console button.
ryan: thanks all. I'll draft the RFC and a small PR for the schema change. next check-in in #eng-platform tomorrow after the initial 10% canary. :thumbsup:
